name: desktop-steward
description: Let Claude tidy, find and organize your files safely. Plain rules, asks before anything risky, and every change can be undone.
long_description:
Desktop Steward gives Claude safe hands on your computer.

* Choose which folders Claude may read and which it may change
* Claude always asks before deleting or replacing anything
* Every change can be undone for 7 days
* Ready-made tasks: tidy Downloads, find duplicate photos, free disk space, find documents

No terminal, no cloud, nothing leaves your computer.

read_folders.title: Folders Claude may read
read_folders.description: Optional. Leave empty for Desktop, Documents, Downloads and Pictures.

write_folders.title: Folders Claude may change
write_folders.description: Optional. Leave empty for Documents/AI Workspace and Downloads. Claude may create, move and (after asking) delete files only here.

ask_before_delete.title: Ask before deleting
ask_before_delete.description: Recommended. Deleted files are kept for 7 days either way.
